name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* Content push: the pages, posts, Elementor templates, blocks, menus and new images changed on a local copy go up on their own, with addresses and links fixed, and nothing else in the database is touched. Anything edited on the live website since it was pulled is held back unless you choose to overwrite it.
* Every content push is backed up first and can be undone.
